## MR CAUSE
- CAUSE is used to address issues of correlated pleiotropy and is more robust

```{r }
library(readr)
library(cause)
library(dplyr)

```

#### Checking Loneliness <-> Triglycerides

```{r loading loneliness and tg}
PATH_PAN_LONELY <- "/vast/palmer/scratch/polimanti/ejm96/metal_ldsc_pipeline/primary_clean/005_Loneliness_isolation_PanUKB_clean.tsv.gz"
loneliness <- read_tsv(PATH_PAN_LONELY)

PATH_TG <- "/vast/palmer/scratch/polimanti/ejm96/metal_ldsc_pipeline/metal_ivw/Triglycerides_METAL_combined.tsv.gz"
tg <- read_tsv(PATH_TG)

colnames(loneliness)
colnames(tg)
```
```{r checking colnames}
head(loneliness)
head(tg)

```

```{r harmonizing and formatting}
lone_tg <- cause::gwas_merge(
  loneliness,
  tg,
  snp_name_cols = c("SNP", "SNP"),
  beta_hat_cols = c("BETA", "BETA"),
  se_cols = c("SE", "SE"),
  A1_cols = c("A1", "A1"),
  A2_cols = c("A2", "A2")
)
```

```{r}
set.seed(100)
varlist <- with(lone_tg, sample(snp, size=1000000, replace=FALSE))
params <- est_cause_params(lone_tg, varlist)
```
